entries.japanese:
{unclassified-control:14}＊＊＊　冒険の１０の心得　＊＊＊

{unclassified-control:14}著者　　王様


１　自分とモンスターは順番に動く。
　　あせることなかれ！
２　道具を見たり　向きを変えるのは
　　動作したことにはならん！

３　にげるときは
　　敵のナナメ攻撃に注意せよ！
４　歩いているとHPは回復する。
　　あぶなくなったら　まずにげろ！

５　敵が寝ているか起きているかを
　　たしかめること！
　　すべてのモンスターを
　　たおす必要はない！

６　にげられない時は　ルーラ草をのむ！
　　まどわし草は　モンスターに投げる！
７　薬草や弟切草は　HPが最高のときに
　　のむと　最大HPが少し上がる。

８　いかずちの杖は　必ずあたる！
　　バシルーラの杖は　敵をとばす！
９　メダパニの杖は　フラフラにさせ
　　ラリホーの杖は　相手をねむらせる！

１０　毒で下がった「ちから」は
　　　毒けし草で　もとにもどす！
　　　ちからのたねは　そのあとでのむ！


{unclassified-control:14}おわりじゃ
entries.draft:
{center}*** Ten Tips for Adventurers ***

{center}By the King

1. You and the monsters take turns. Do not rush!

2. Checking your items or changing direction does not use up a turn.

3. When fleeing, watch out for enemies attacking diagonally!

4. Walking restores HP. When danger threatens, run away first!

5. Check whether monsters are asleep or awake. You need not defeat every monster!

6. Eat a Zoom herb when you cannot escape. Throw a Misleader herb at a monster!

7. Eat a Medicinal herb or Super herb at full HP to raise your maximum HP a little.

8. A Lightning staff never misses! A Bazoom staff sends enemies away!

9. A Fuddle staff confuses your foe. A Snooze staff puts your foe to sleep!

10. Restore strength lost to poison with an Antidotal herb. Only then should you eat a Seed of strength!

{center}That is all.
entries.english:
{center}*** Ten Tips for Adventurers ***

{center}By the King

1. You and the monsters take turns. Do not rush!

2. Checking your items or changing direction does not use up a turn.

3. When fleeing, watch out for enemies attacking diagonally!

4. Walking restores HP. When danger threatens, run away first!

5. Check if monsters are awake or asleep. You needn't defeat them all!

6. Drink a Zoom herb if trapped! Throw Misleader herbs at monsters!

7. At full HP, drinking a Medicinal herb or Super herb raises max HP a little.

8. A Lightning staff never misses! A Bazoom staff sends enemies away!

9. A Fuddle staff confuses your foe. A Snooze staff puts your foe to sleep!

10. Use an Antidotal herb to restore strength lost to poison.

Only then drink a Seed of strength!

{center}That is all.
entries.reason: Read all ten Japanese tips independently against the draft. Preserve alternating turns; inspection/facing cost no turn; diagonal danger; walking recovery; sleeping/awake distinction; not all foes need defeating; eat versus throw; full-HP condition and small maximum-HP increase; distinct staff effects; poison recovery before the strength seed. Retain all three centred headings and the King's direct, unembellished voice. Terminology evidence and its limits are recorded in the glossary; no PS1 guide prose or mechanics copied.
